verdict.rationale: Stripe provides an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API via natural-language-driven tool calls, and Stripe Issuing is presented as part of the broader Stripe API surface, so an AI-native user could plausibly drive Issuing actions (create cards, cardholders, etc.) through this interface. However, the evidence never confirms the MCP server explicitly exposes Issuing-specific tools/endpoints, and no independent or hands-on report validates natural-language operation of Issuing itself. missing for 10: Issuing-specific MCP tool documentation, independent/hands-on confirmation of natural-language Issuing operations.
